notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP only (curl with Chrome UA, no impersonation needed), no block encountered on ikea.com for the French site; robots.txt (ikea.com, shared across locales) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot disallow and only blocks specific query-param/search-result/fragment paths and AmazonProductDiscoverybot (unrelated bot), none of which were used; sitemap present (sitemaps/sitemap.xml). TREE: built via direct HTTP fetch of https://www.ikea.com/fr/fr/cat/<slug>-<id>/ for each category page and parsing the embedded 'hierarchyObjs' JSON blob (the site's own categorisation tree, identical structural node IDs to the already-extracted IKEA UK (SR92) and IKEA DE (SR107) global taxonomy, just localised titles) to get each node's true parent/children; cross-checked candidate leaf/group boundaries against IKEA UK's (SR92, ts92.json) already-validated inclusion/exclusion decisions since the platform uses one shared global category-ID taxonomy across locales -- every id used below was independently re-fetched and re-verified against the live French site tree, not copied blind. Roots crawled: Textiles & tapis (tl001), Rideaux/tringles/stores (tl002), Accessoires de rangement (st007), Rangements/storage furniture (st001), Conservation et rangement des aliments (15937, filed under Cuisine & electromenager kt001 but storage-relevant), Buanderie (lc001, storage-relevant subset only: laundry baskets + laundry cabinets), Salle de bain (ba001, storage-relevant subset only: bathroom boxes/baskets, shelving, wall/tall cabinets, trolleys) and Bebe & enfant storage/textile branches (bc001/bc002/bc003/18690/18706/18730). QTY: obtained via IKEA's own internal listing/search API (POST https://sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/fr/fr/search?c=listaf&v=20250507, searchParameters={input:<categoryId>, type:CATEGORY}), whose exact request body/headers were captured from a live rendered category page's own network traffic via a short headless Playwright session, then replayed directly over plain HTTP (no browser) for every category id; window size 300 by default, auto-retried at window=700 whenever the returned metadata.max reached >=300 to guarantee the true total is not truncated (Wardrobes 19053 returned 606 at window=700, confirmed not clipped). Each response's metadata.categoryPage.categoryName was checked against the requested node's own French title to confirm the correct category was returned (h1/canonical-equivalent validation) before recording qty. This is the exact same total the site itself renders on each category page. EXCLUDED: Vetements et accessoires (42925, apparel), Tringles a rideau et rails (18891, hardware), Accessoires couture (14350, notions/tools not fabric product), Films et accessoires pour fenetres (700628, adhesive window film not textile), Stores venitiens (700599, slat venetian blinds - not fabric/textile), Anti-derapants et thibaudes (10699, rubber/PVC rug-grip accessory not a rug/textile itself), named IKEA product systems/series used as cross-cutting collection hubs rather than standard taxonomy (Solutions de rangement/PAX-style systems 46052, BOAXEL/JONAXEL sub-nodes rolled into the parent Wall Shelves total, storage-solution-systems) per the View All/Collections exclusion rule, Poubelles/waste-bin branch (16213/34470/16215/48940 - waste disposal, not organisational storage of belongings), plain Cintres/Hangers (20618, not a storage container/organizer), Tableaux d'affichage (10574, noticeboards - not storage), Materiel de demenagement (46078, packing/moving supplies not home storage), personal-carry Bagagerie (sacs en toile/tote 16295, sacs a dos/backpacks 27821, accessoires de voyage/travel accessories 16255, sacs isothermes/cool bags 46082 - fashion/travel carrying items excluded per storage.md Sec.6, only Organiseurs de bagage/bag organisers 47441 kept), Meubles sous vasques/lavabos and other bathroom fixtures/vanities/mirrors/lighting/countertops/sinks/taps/showers/stools-benches (ba001 fixtures, not storage), most of Buanderie/Laundry & cleaning (Poubelles waste bins, Accessoires vaisselle dishwashing accessories, Etendoirs a linge drying racks, Planches a repasser ironing boards, Lave-linge/seche-linge washing machines/dryers - not storage), Meubles TV/TV & media furniture (10475), Separateurs de piece/room dividers (46080), Ensembles de meubles de couloir/hallway furniture sets (700411, mixed furniture set), Solutions de rangement 46052 and its garage-system sub-branches (IVAR/BROR/OMAR-equivalent) collapsed, keeping only the non-series 'Etageres'/Complete Wall Shelves (20660) leaf under a separate Garage Storage heading, matching IKEA UK's (SR92) established treatment for the identical cross-linked node; the fuller BOAXEL/cube/floating-shelf sub-variants under Etageres murales (10398) were likewise rolled up into the single 'Wall Shelves' aggregate row rather than exploded into 11 near-duplicate style rows, since all are the same product type differing only by mounting/style. Gourdes et thermos (700352, water bottles/travel mugs - not storage) and Accessoires de nettoyage (20609, cleaning tools) excluded from Food/Laundry storage branches. Duplicate cross-linked nodes (same category ID reachable from more than one menu path, e.g. Serviettes et gants de toilette enfant 18700 appearing under both Textile bebe and Textile enfant; Paniers a linge 20601 appearing under both Organiseurs pour vetements and Buanderie; Rangements papier et multimedia 16202 appearing under both Boites de rangement et paniers and Organisateurs de bureau) were each recorded exactly once under their single most specific/primary parent, never duplicated. Peignoir et accessoires de spa (700339) flagged LOW confidence/MANUAL REVIEW as it mixes bathrobes (textile) with slippers and other spa accessories (non-textile) in one listing page, matching IKEA UK's identical flag on the equivalent node.
